verdict.rationale: Bitwarden Send has its own retention controls: a user reports setting an expiry date and a view limit so shared data would not persist, and a support exchange shows account deletion is available. Both come only from community anecdotes, not first-party docs on retention or deletion. Vault export is a portability feature, not a retention control, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of account/vault deletion, documented retention or purge policies (including server-side deletion guarantees and backups), auto-deletion settings beyond Send, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: They set an expiry date and a 2-view limit so the data wouldn't be captured by passive email logging.
Their only suggested fix was to export data, delete the account, recreate it and re-import
